notes: I fit the data to y ≈ -1.2·x⁴ - 3.2·x³, which matches nearly every point in E1–E3 to high precision. The one clear exception is x=-102.2 (E3), where the observed value is ~5× smaller in magnitude than the formula predicts — possibly a different-behavior region for very negative x, but with only one sample I can't pin its boundary, so I've left the main formula in place (marked as uncertain).
